notes.title: HeatStroke v1.1
notes.content:
Hey all! Matt here, the programmer for HeatStroke bringing you our very first patch notes.
We're about a week out from launch now and have just pushed a patch to polish up a few rough edges on our desert masochism simulator.

Here are the changes included in tonight's patch:

- Added a disclaimer screen that appears before entering the game for the first time, to help those who are misinformed or unprepared for the journey ahead of them.
(Note: You may see this disclaimer even if you've played the game before, don't worry! It'll only show up once.)
- Polished up the graphics on the "pause" menu.
- Fixed the air freshener selection buttons on the main menu.

I'd like to share a big thanks to everyone who has played the game so far, we really appreciate all the support and reviews from those who have played so far.
If there are any outstanding issues you've found in HeatStroke that haven't been addressed here, please feel free to let us know by joining our Discord server here: ItsTheTalia Games Discord
